hero.headline: AI that takes the repetitive work off your team.
hero.subline: From computer vision on the factory floor to workflow automation across HR and operations, I build AI systems around your process and your data. Tell me the problem and I'll design the solution.

about.headline: AI engineer where models meet operations.
about.intro: I'm an AI engineer who works where models meet operations: cameras on production lines, documents in HR pipelines, agents inside business tools.
about.body: I care about systems that are measurable, maintainable and handed over properly. Most of my work starts with a messy real-world input (a line camera, a pile of applications, a weekly report) and ends with an API or workflow a team uses every day. I'm a co-author of a peer-reviewed IEEE Access paper (2025) on AI for smart agriculture.
